questions.stem: Which statement gives the analysts group read access to the table sales.gold.orders?

options.text: GRANT SELECT ON TABLE sales.gold.orders TO `analysts`
GRANT READ_FILES ON TABLE sales.gold.orders TO `analysts`

questions.explanation: Unity Catalog privileges are given with `GRANT <privilege> ON <object> TO <principal>`.

questions.stem: Which statement removes the SELECT access that `analysts` has on sales.gold.orders?

options.text: REMOVE SELECT ON TABLE sales.gold.orders FROM `analysts`
REVOKE SELECT ON TABLE sales.gold.orders FROM `analysts`

questions.explanation: REVOKE removes a privilege that GRANT gave; the page's examples use GRANT and REVOKE.

questions.stem: An analyst has SELECT on sales.gold.orders but still cannot query it. Which other privileges does the analyst need? Choose two.
questions.explanation: To reach a table a user needs USE CATALOG on its catalog and USE SCHEMA on its schema, as well as SELECT.

questions.stem: A platform team wants to stop one group from managing permissions on a schema's tables, even if someone later grants it that right. What does Unity Catalog offer?

options.text: An ABAC DENY policy (Beta) on MANAGE ACCESS CONTROL
REVOKE MANAGE on each of the schema's tables from the group now

questions.explanation: DENY policies are a Beta ABAC feature, and they support one privilege, MANAGE ACCESS CONTROL. SELECT and MODIFY aren't supported by DENY policies.

questions.stem: You grant SELECT on the schema sales.gold to a group. Which tables can the group read?

options.text: Only the views in the schema, not its tables
Only tables created before the grant
All current and future tables in that schema, given USE CATALOG and USE SCHEMA

questions.explanation: A grant on a schema applies to its current and future objects; USE CATALOG and USE SCHEMA are needed to reach anything inside.
